profile.name: SMPTE ST 2084 / ITU-R BT.2100 PQ EOTF

negative_controls_required: signals below zero or above one must reject
luminance below zero or above 10000 cd/m2 must reject
PQ luminance must be reported in cd/m2 and not confused with normalized relative luminance
PQ EOTF decoding must not be described as tone mapping or physical display measurement
limitations: UNQUALIFIED analytic reference fixture; software checks do not certify an HDR display.
PQ describes a nominal absolute-luminance transfer mapping, not a panel-specific tone curve or capability.
No physical display or calibrated photometer was used.
The canonical black encode selects zero signal because the EOTF's clipped numerator maps a small lower signal interval to zero luminance.
